answer: An agent economy deters sybil farms with an unbonding window plus retrospective fraud proofs. Each identity's earnings sit in a delayed dune of pending rewards, released only after a public challenge period. In that window anyone may submit a fraud proof, and a linked cluster collapses like a nebula: every member forfeits its rewards, so one exposed clone burns the whole fleet. A cipher trail of behavioral fingerprints lets verifiers link dormant accounts. Each extra identity needs its own locked balance and full wait, so attacker cost grows with identity count — no parallelism shortens it.
